acceptance: Record the exact current 502/container/manifest state and deployment run 31250996848 before mutation.

Use only the existing dev environment lease and deployment authority for the smallest temporary recovery; label it temporary and restore a public BFF readiness and version 200 without changing safe write defaults.
Do not repair Source Ingestion product code in this task; route a reproduced service-code defect to L12-MIN-SRC-20260808.
Make an unhealthy dependency or candidate fail before the serving incumbent is lost, or automatically restore the captured incumbent BFF and exact manifest before releasing the lease.
A failed candidate must not leave operator-bff unserved in Created state and must not publish a new deployment manifest.
Add deterministic failure-injection coverage for source-ingest unhealthy, candidate BFF readiness failure, rollback success, rollback failure, and unchanged manifest.
Deliver the permanent source change through PR, independent exact-head review, merge, and one bounded dev deployment; record served FE/BFF identities, rollback baseline, readiness, and safe posture.

out_of_scope: shared L12 catalog and Compose files
live capital or automatic deployment approval

Policy Learning scheduler and persistence tests
tasks.rollout: Merge after all three component predecessors; enable only the paper/shadow development path.

tasks.title: Build a non-self-attesting Agora cross-loop verifier
tasks.summary: Verify the correlated tenant-safe chain with real service calls, durable readbacks, restart and negative controls rather than literal pass output.
acceptance: Invoke actual authenticated service routes and durable API or database readbacks; fail closed when any required service is absent.
Capture exact interaction, evidence, dataset version, handoff, acknowledgement, candidate, consultation request, and memo identifiers in one correlated result.
Verify duplicate/idempotency conflict behavior, acknowledgement ordering, tenant isolation, restart readback, failure-to-DLQ, and replay to successful terminal output.
Record safe write posture and prove unauthorized or disallowed writes fail without weakening strict authentication.
Record aggregate backlog counts before and after the test and never purge or bulk-acknowledge historical rows.
The verifier must return nonzero for a missing service, mismatched tenant, missing durable readback, unacknowledged handoff, missing candidate, or missing consultation memo.
Independent review must inspect the verifier source and raw evidence; owner-authored review_approved is invalid.
validation: unit tests with service and database failure injection
tasks.rollout: Verifier-only source merge; product failures return to the owning component or integration task.
tasks.rollback: Revert the verifier merge; do not change product/runtime state as rollback.

tasks.title: Reaccept the current Agora hosted exact pair

Run AGORA-L12-REAL-VERIFIER-20260808 against hosted dev and require the correlated chain and all negative controls to pass.
Restart the BFF through governed dev authority and prove the same durable records and exact pair remain readable afterward.
Prove live mode, strict fallback, no embedded token, read-only profile, real writes false, stub writes false, unauthorized failures, and governed write rejection.
Reject stale, historical, fallback, local-only, self-attested, unreviewed, or manifest-only evidence.
On any failure, keep or restore the last accepted exact pair and leave the candidate unaccepted.

tasks.rollout: One bounded dev exact-pair admission through the existing deployment workflow after every predecessor merge.
tasks.rollback: Keep or reselect the previous accepted exact pair and preserve its manifest; never switch on failed proof.
